bio.text: Mike Carey was sworn in to the U.S. House on November 4, 2021, and represents Ohio's 15th Congressional District.
Born in 1971, he was raised in Sabina, Ohio, and served as an officer in the military after an ROTC scholarship; he earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University.
He worked for more than 20 years as an executive at an Ohio-headquartered energy company and lives in Columbus.
